items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). CMC tempted for more slot with WR injuries (Black presence); rarely buy RB-as-WR but this case yes. Kmet IR season-ending juice for Burden (2.56 YPRR, 68.8% routes; less 2/3-sets).

items.implication: Kittle TE1 elite; CMC multi-position; Burden WR upside Chicago.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets concentrate; Burden more juice post-Kmet.
